clips.title: The story
paras: On Guard in Stonetalon directs Alliance travelers from Kaela Shadowspear to Gaxim Rustfizzle at their camp near Windshear Crag. Facing rampant despoilment by the Venture Company, an otherwise unlikely pair—a cautious night elf sentinel and an eccentric gnome tinkerer—join forces to safeguard the mountain pass.

Night elves and gnomes rarely share common ground, especially when it comes to technology and the natural world. In the crags of Stonetalon Mountains, however, necessity bridges the cultural gulf. With the rapacious Venture Company carving out the wilderness and felling ancient trees, the sentinel Kaela Shadowspear has recognized that pure martial prowess alone cannot overcome industrialized pillaging. Welcoming gnome ingenuity into sacred Kaldorei territory demonstrates just how precarious the situation has become.

Gaxim Rustfizzle represents the eccentric pragmatism of the Alliance's smaller allies. While night elf society famously turned its back on arcane excess millennia ago, Gaxim believes that abstaining from magic and technical innovation leaves them vulnerable. By pairing alchemy and engineering with a touch of arcane discipline, Gaxim aims to convince his Kaldorei hosts that practical science can defend nature just as effectively as bow and glaive.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The situation here in Stonetalon is obviously grave for a night elf and gnome to be working together.
The Venture Co. Has devastated these lands and I've spent most of my time putting an end to the destruction.
Do not judge Gaxim prematurely; he understands the need for us to work together.
If you wish to aid us, then start by speaking to Gaxim.
I'm sorry I cannot send you back to Tara with good news yet. Perhaps soon.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Treacherous... Treacherous and dangerous, that's what this land is.
But I'm here to show the night elves that it's a little safer with the help of good ole engineering and a dash of magic.
See, swearing off magic completely won't help the night elves--they need it. The world needs it. And with engineering and alchemy to boot, you can't go wrong. The possibilities are endless.
